contributor_notes: A queer reimagining of Pride and Prejudice set on Fire Island. All characters are described in the source as gay; more specific labels aren't given. The source notes the film explores racial biases excluding queer Asian Americans (racism trigger warning). Happy-ending was not confirmed by the source text despite the romance framing, so it was left off pending maintainer review. No subtitle/audio language info provided.
